candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to d_resid4. Record rho, rho_abs, exact within-Ser p, exact sixfold-family p, and global matched-support p. This candidate is only an auditable route, not a verdict, unless it passes coverage, residual-norm, independence, and projection gates.
candidate_axes.construction: For each mature tRNA, discard anticodon bases 34, 35, 36 and discard any feature explicitly annotated as wobble-position decoding. Encode only non-wobble modification features at positions 32, 37, 38 and body positions: binary presence, chemistry class counts, enzyme-family counts, and evidence-weighted modification burden. Within each organism, z-score each feature across tRNA isodecoders, map tRNAs to their directly cognate standard-code codons, aggregate multiple isodecoders per codon by median, then aggregate organisms by median to obtain a 61-vector x. Residualize x against the locked forbidden matrix C containing intercept, amino-acid one-hot, tRNA supply/tAI, tRNA consensus loading, f3/ramp, d_perp, optimal_loading, GC1/GC2/GC3/total_GC, wobble class, codon-pair incoming/outgoing scores, mRNA-stability score, and ribosome-dwell score. If r=(I-P_C)x is nonzero, set d_resid4=r/||r||_2.
controls: Position-34, anticodon-base, and wobble-decoding features are excluded before modeling.
Gene-copy number, tAI, and any expression-derived tRNA abundance column are controls only, never inputs to x.

Reject the axis if residual x is predictable from tRNA supply, f3/ramp, d_perp, GC, wobble class, codon-pair scores, mRNA stability, or ribosome dwell at preregistered adjusted R2 >= 0.05 in held-out organisms.
Run leave-one-organism and leave-one-enzyme-family audits; the sign and material SerSplit projection must not depend on a single clade or a single modification enzyme.
Negative controls: repeat with permuted modification positions within each tRNA body and with anticodon labels permuted within isotype; both must lose the SerSplit projection.
data_sources: MODOMICS tRNA modification table: organism, tRNA isotype, anticodon, mature-position number, modification identity, enzyme, evidence type
GtRNAdb 2.0 or tRNADB-CE tRNA records for the locked organism panel: organism, tRNA gene ID, isotype, anticodon, predicted mature sequence, isodecoder family
standard-code 61-sense-codon table and locked codon order from the local selection-vector packet
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if non-wobble modification coverage is sparse for Ser UCN or AGY codons, if residualization removes nearly all variance, if the result is driven by tRNA abundance or anticodon/wobble annotations, or if SerSplit projection is not stable under leave-one-source audits.
candidate_axes.name: non_wobble_tRNA_modification_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the residualized kinetic axis. Also run an assay-source split: public-only versus fill-in-only projections must have the same nonzero sign after the sign convention is locked by the training half.
candidate_axes.construction: Use only wild-type, full-length, cognate aminoacylation assays. Exclude assays where the measured substrate is an anticodon mutant, minihelix-only substrate, noncognate mischarging substrate, or abundance proxy. Convert kcat/Km to log10 units; within each organism-aaRS-assay-method block, subtract the amino-acid-specific median and divide by MAD. Map each tRNA substrate to decoded standard codon; aggregate technical replicates by inverse-variance weighted mean, isodecoders by median, and organisms by random-effects meta-analytic mean to obtain x over 61 codons. Residualize x against C and define d_resid4=r/||r||_2 if ||r||_2 is above the locked tolerance.
controls: Amino-acid one-hot is included in C, so any amino-acid-level Ser effect is removed before testing the Ser UCN versus AGY split.
Anticodon-mutation assays are excluded, preventing an anticodon/wobble mechanism from becoming the raw axis.
Assay batch, organism, temperature, pH, and method are normalized before codon aggregation.
tRNA supply, tRNA consensus, f3/ramp, d_perp, GC, wobble, codon-pair, mRNA-stability, and ribosome-dwell controls are residualized after aggregation.
Coverage gate: every sense codon must have direct or preregistered fill-in kinetic support; otherwise the candidate remains incomplete.
data_sources: BRENDA and SABIO-RK aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase assay records: enzyme, organism, tRNA substrate, amino acid, kcat, Km, kcat/Km, temperature, pH, buffer, assay method
manual primary-literature extraction table for full-length cognate tRNA aminoacylation kinetics
bounded fill-in experiment if public coverage is incomplete: purified cognate mature tRNA panel with at least one directly assigned tRNA substrate for each of the 61 sense codons
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if fewer than 61 codons have direct kinetic values, if Ser codon values are inferred only from anticodon identity, if organism or assay-method effects dominate, or if the SerSplit projection disappears after amino-acid and tRNA controls.
candidate_axes.name: aaRS_aminoacylation_kinetics_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the EF-Tu/EF1A residual axis. Projection is interpreted only as a candidate-axis hit if the same sign appears in at least two independent assay sources or in one public source plus the bounded fill-in panel.
candidate_axes.construction: For each charged tRNA substrate, compute deltaG=RT ln(Kd) or use reported deltaG. Within each organism and elongation-factor assay block, subtract the amino-acid median to remove amino-acid-side-chain binding compensation. Exclude uncharged tRNA, minihelix, anticodon-mutant, and wobble-only constructs. Map charged tRNAs to codons by direct cognate assignment; aggregate isodecoders and organisms as robust medians to form x. Residualize x against C and normalize the residual to d_resid4.
controls: The raw score is binding thermodynamics of charged tRNA, not tRNA abundance, codon usage, or ribosome dwell.
Amino-acid one-hot, tRNA supply, tRNA consensus, wobble class, f3/ramp, d_perp, GC, codon-pair, mRNA-stability, and ribosome-dwell scores are controls.
Reject if binding values correlate with tAI or gene copy after residualization.
Run charged-versus-uncharged exclusion audit: uncharged-tRNA controls must not produce the same SerSplit projection.
Run buffer/method leave-one-out audits.
data_sources: published EF-Tu or EF1A aminoacyl-tRNA binding datasets with Kd, kon, koff, or deltaG for charged full-length tRNAs
tRNA substrate metadata: organism, amino acid, anticodon, mature sequence, charging enzyme, modification state
bounded fill-in binding panel: one purified charged mature tRNA per sense codon, same EF-Tu/EF1A preparation and buffer
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if full 61-codon charged-tRNA coverage cannot be obtained, if Ser UCN or AGY values are inferred from shared amino-acid effects, if EF-Tu affinity is collinear with tRNA consensus loading, or if the projection is assay-batch-specific.
candidate_axes.name: EF_Tu_charged_tRNA_binding_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the lability residual axis. Report whether the projection survives the exclusion of events annotated as tRNA-loss, wobble-driven, GC-driven, or codon-disappearance-driven.
candidate_axes.construction: For each standard-code sense codon, count phylogenetically deduplicated independent reassignment or ambiguous-assignment events in which that codon changes amino-acid meaning or becomes stop. Exclude events whose only support is tRNA abundance loss, codon disappearance, or wobble expansion unless an independent genomic/translation assignment is present. Normalize as x_i=log((events_i+0.5)/(opportunities_i-events_i+0.5)), where opportunities are the number of screened independent clades in which the codon was observable. Residualize x against C plus codon-family degeneracy and stop-adjacency indicators; normalize the residual to d_resid4 if nonzero.
controls: Phylogenetic deduplication prevents one clade expansion from counting as many events.
GC, codon disappearance, tRNA loss/supply, wobble class, codon-pair effects, mRNA stability, and ribosome dwell are controls or exclusion reasons, not explanatory inputs.
Remove all stop codons from the tested 61-vector; stop-adjacency is a control only.
Repeat after excluding mitochondrial codes and after excluding bacterial/archaeal candidate recodings; projection must not be unique to one domain.
Negative control: randomize reassignment events across codons within equal degeneracy classes and recompute the projection.
data_sources: NCBI Genetic Codes table snapshot: code ID, taxon scope, codon assignment, evidence note
Codetta or equivalent alternative-code screen calls on GTDB representative genomes: genome ID, codon reassignment, confidence, clade, inferred mechanism if annotated
GTDB or NCBI taxonomy tree for phylogenetic deduplication of reassignment events
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if reassignment counts are too sparse, if SerSplit signal is fully explained by alternative-code mechanisms involving tRNA supply or wobble, if AGY/UCN differences are driven by stop-adjacent recoding artifacts, or if residualization collapses the axis.
candidate_axes.name: codon_assignment_lability_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the residual mutability axis after all DNA-context controls. Also report rho after removing CpG-containing codons and after matching UCN and AGY codons by genome-wide opportunity where possible.
candidate_axes.construction: For each sense codon, compute an opportunity-normalized synonymous mutation burden: observed rare synonymous SNVs from that codon divided by callable occurrences of that codon, stratified by strand, methylated-CpG status, local trinucleotide context, replication timing if available, and gene constraint. Use only variants classified as synonymous in the locked transcript set; exclude codon changes affecting splice motifs or overlapping regulatory annotations. Fit a neutral-context model from noncoding or fourfold-degenerate sites, subtract expected mutation burden, and aggregate the residual by codon to x. Residualize x against C plus explicit CpG/UpA and local trinucleotide mutability columns; normalize to d_resid4.
controls: The raw axis is DNA damage/repair or mutability residual, not translation efficiency, tRNA supply, ribosome dwell, mRNA stability, or codon-pair usage.
GC1/GC2/GC3/total_GC, CpG, TpA/UpA, methylation, trinucleotide mutation opportunity, codon-pair scores, mRNA-stability scores, and dwell scores are controls.
Exclude disease-enriched, splice-proximal, nonsense-adjacent, and overlapping functional elements.
Repeat in separate ancestry groups and in de novo-only data; the candidate is rejected if projection exists only in one ascertainment source.
Negative control: use intronic pseudo-codons in the same genes and reading-frame phases; they must not reproduce the SerSplit projection.
data_sources: gnomAD or comparable population coding SNV table: variant, allele count, allele number, gene, transcript, codon position, ancestral/ref/alt allele, consequence
de novo mutation or near-neutral pedigree mutation table with callable opportunity mask
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation: transcript sequence, codon, reading frame, exon, strand
COSMIC/PCAWG mutational-signature exposure table only as a control source, not as the raw axis
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if GC/CpG/trinucleotide context explains the residual, if coding selection or splice/regulatory overlap drives the score, if the 61-codon opportunity table is incomplete, or if SerSplit projection is absent in de novo mutation data.
candidate_axes.name: synonymous_DNA_damage_repair_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the editing residual axis. Report projections separately for A-to-I-only, C-to-U-only, and combined axes; only preregistered combined or replicated type-specific projections are considered candidate hits.
candidate_axes.construction: Map high-confidence RNA editing sites into CDS codons. For each sense codon, compute editing burden per callable expressed codon occurrence, separately for A-to-I and C-to-U, requiring minimum read depth and excluding known DNA variants. Normalize within tissue by expression, coverage, editable-base opportunity, and local sequence motif; combine tissues by median or random-effects meta-analysis to produce x. Residualize x against C plus expression, editable-base count, ADAR/APOBEC motif score, RBP density, and mRNA half-life; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: DNA SNPs and mapping-ambiguous sites are excluded.
mRNA stability, expression, coverage, local editing motif, GC, codon-pair, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, d_perp, wobble, and ribosome dwell are residualized or matched.
Run tissue leave-one-out and editing-type-specific audits.
Negative control: shift CDS reading frame by +1 and +2 before codon aggregation; shifted pseudo-codons must not reproduce the projection.
Reject if SerSplit projection is driven by a single tissue, transcript family, or editable-base composition.
data_sources: REDIportal, RADAR, or equivalent A-to-I and C-to-U RNA editing calls: genomic coordinate, transcript, editing type, editing level, coverage, tissue, strand
GTEx or ENCODE RNA-seq coverage/expression table for opportunity normalization
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation with codon coordinate and reading frame
mRNA half-life and RNA-binding-protein annotation tracks used only as controls
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if RNA editing burden is explained by editable-base composition, expression, mRNA half-life, local motifs, or mapping artifacts, or if coverage is insufficient for all 61 sense codons.
candidate_axes.name: coding_RNA_editing_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to each preregistered modification-type residual and to the combined residual after Holm correction over modification types. No biological-axis claim is made from a single unreplicated modification source.
candidate_axes.construction: Map mRNA modification calls inside coding regions to codon identity and codon position. For each sense codon, compute opportunity-normalized modification burden per expressed codon occurrence, stratified by modification type and codon position. Normalize within study and tissue by expression, coverage, modification-calling platform, local motif score, and codon-position opportunity; aggregate across studies by robust median to obtain x. Residualize x against C plus mRNA half-life, predicted local structure, RBP motif density, and known modification motifs; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: mRNA stability and local RNA structure are controls, not the candidate axis.
GC, motif content, codon-pair score, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, d_perp, wobble, and ribosome dwell are residualized.
Run platform-specific audits: antibody-based, nanopore/direct-RNA, and chemical-mapping calls are tested separately where available.
Negative control: use UTR modification calls randomly assigned to CDS codons by expression-matched transcript; projection must vanish.
Reject modification types with fewer than a preregistered minimum number of codon-mapped events.
data_sources: RMBase, m6A-Atlas, DirectRMDB, or equivalent transcriptome modification calls: modification type, coordinate, transcript, tissue/cell type, confidence, stoichiometry if available
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation: transcript sequence, codon coordinate, reading frame
matched expression, mRNA half-life, local motif, and structure tracks used as controls
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if modification calls are motif/GC/stability artifacts, if platform bias dominates, if events are too sparse for 61 codons, or if SerSplit projection is not replicated across independent mapping technologies.
candidate_axes.name: mRNA_base_modification_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the MAVE residual codon-effect axis. Report public-only, assay-type-specific, and leave-one-gene projections; the route remains exploratory unless projection is stable across independent assays.
candidate_axes.construction: Extract only synonymous single-codon substitutions from multiplexed assays. Convert each variant score to an effect of using the alternate codon relative to the reference codon within the same amino acid and local protein position. Fit a mixed model with random intercepts for gene, assay, protein position, amino acid, source codon, target codon, and replicate; take the best linear unbiased codon-use effect for each of the 61 codons as x. Residualize x against C plus assay-specific RNA-structure, codon-pair, mRNA-stability, and dwell covariates; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: Only synonymous substitutions are used; nonsynonymous and splice/regulatory variants are excluded.
Amino-acid identity, gene, protein position, assay, source codon, target codon, expression, codon-pair, mRNA stability, ribosome dwell, GC, wobble, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, and d_perp are controlled.
Leave-one-gene-family and leave-one-assay-type audits are required.
Negative control: permute synonymous scores within amino acid and gene while preserving codon counts; projection must vanish.
Reject if SerSplit projection is carried by one gene, one assay, or one codon substitution direction.
data_sources: MaveDB and ProteinGym synonymous variant tables: variant sequence, reference codon, alternate codon, score, raw counts, replicate ID, assay type, selection condition
gene/transcript annotation for each MAVE library: CDS position, amino acid, codon context, expression construct, library design
matched codon-pair, RNA-structure, mRNA-stability, and ribosome-profiling controls for each assayed gene where available
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if MAVE coverage does not span all 61 codons, if effects are dominated by mRNA stability/codon-pair/dwell terms, if synonymous scores are too assay-specific, or if the model cannot identify codon effects separately from gene and position effects.
candidate_axes.name: synonymous_MAVE_effect_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT separately to each lesion chemistry and to any preregistered combined lesion axis. Report whether projection survives explicit GC and nearest-neighbor residualization.
candidate_axes.construction: Synthesize oligos in which only the central codon varies across the 61 sense codons and all flanking bases, concentration, exposure, time, temperature, and buffer are identical. For each damage chemistry, estimate lesion rate per molecule from raw replicate counts. Within chemistry and replicate batch, z-score lesion rates; aggregate independent chemistries only if preregistered or keep separate axes. The raw codon lesion vector x is then residualized against C plus explicit base-composition, purine/pyrimidine, CpG/UpA, and nearest-neighbor thermodynamic controls; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: No tRNA, codon usage, mRNA stability, codon-pair, ribosome, or expression data enter the raw axis.
Identical flanking contexts remove codon-pair and local transcript-context effects at the experimental design stage.
GC, nearest-neighbor chemistry, CpG/UpA, and base-position composition are residualized.
Run DNA-only and RNA-only panels separately; projection must not depend on a single chemistry unless that chemistry was preregistered.
Negative control: replicate the panel with scrambled codon labels before analysis; projection must vanish.
data_sources: bounded 61-sense-codon synthetic DNA oligo panel with identical flanking sequence on both sides of the codon
bounded 61-sense-codon synthetic RNA oligo panel with identical flanking sequence on both sides of the codon
LC-MS, primer-extension, nanopore, or sequencing readouts for UV dimerization, oxidative lesions, hydrolytic deamination, and alkylation under fixed exposure conditions
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if lesion-rate differences are fully explained by GC/base composition or nearest-neighbor chemistry, if replicate variance is too high, if synthesis bias differs by codon, or if no residual projection onto u_SerSplit remains.
candidate_axes.name: matched_trinucleotide_chemical_lesion_residual_axis

Existing 64-row selection-vector packet and a 61-row sense-only extract with amino_acid, codon, is_sense, q6_bits, q6_label, d_perp_loading, f3_loading, optimal_loading, trna_consensus_loading, trna_supply_tai_centered_loading, and trna_supply_tai_mean.

Forbidden-control table C_base for the same 61 codons: intercept, 20 amino-acid one-hot columns, GC1, GC2, GC3, total_GC, CpG, UpA, purine/pyrimidine position indicators, wobble class, codon-family degeneracy, and any local graph covariates already used in the Window6--Codon-Q6 bridge.

Codon-pair control table: for each codon, incoming codon-pair residual score, outgoing codon-pair residual score, source organism, transcript set, normalization method, and whether stop-adjacent pairs were excluded.

mRNA-stability control table: per-codon matched-context predicted deltaG or stability contribution, source transcriptome, window size, folding software/version, expression weighting, and GC-controlled residual.

ribosome-dwell control table: per-codon dwell or pause residual from matched ribosome-profiling sources, source organism, protocol, footprint length handling, A/P/E-site assignment, expression threshold, and existing tRNA/GC/stability residualization status.

For tRNA-modification route: MODOMICS/GtRNAdb/tRNADB-CE joined table with organism, tRNA ID, isotype, anticodon, decoded codon set, mature sequence, modification position, modification identity, enzyme, evidence, and abundance/gene-copy columns marked as controls only.

For aaRS route: machine-readable kinetic table with organism, aaRS identity, tRNA substrate ID, anticodon, decoded codon, amino acid, kcat, Km, kcat/Km, replicate, temperature, pH, buffer, assay method, mutation status, and literature source.

For EF-Tu/EF1A route: binding table with organism, elongation factor, charged tRNA substrate ID, amino acid, anticodon, decoded codon, Kd or deltaG, kon, koff if available, buffer, temperature, replicate, modification state, and source.

For alternative-code route: codon reassignment event table with codon, standard assignment, observed assignment, taxon/clade, genome IDs, evidence type, confidence, inferred mechanism, GC content, codon disappearance score, tRNA-loss annotation, and phylogenetic deduplication ID.

For DNA mutability route: codon opportunity table, coding SNV table, de novo mutation table, methylation/CpG flags, local trinucleotide context, callable bases, transcript annotation, and filters for splice/regulatory overlap.

For RNA editing and mRNA modification routes: CDS-mapped event calls with transcript, coordinate, codon, codon position, event type, confidence, coverage, expression, tissue/cell type, platform, known DNA-variant exclusion, local motif, and mRNA half-life control.

For MAVE route: synonymous variant score table with raw counts, normalized scores, replicate IDs, reference codon, alternate codon, amino acid, gene, protein position, assay type, library design, and RNA/codon-context annotations.

For synthetic lesion route: raw replicate count matrix for 61 matched-flank DNA/RNA oligos, synthesis QC, concentration, exposure condition, chemistry, readout method, batch, and codon label key stored separately until after QC.

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the residual mutability axis after all DNA-context controls. Also report rho after removing CpG-containing codons and after matching UCN and AGY codons by genome-wide opportunity where possible.
candidate_axes.construction: For each sense codon, compute an opportunity-normalized synonymous mutation burden: observed rare synonymous SNVs from that codon divided by callable occurrences of that codon, stratified by strand, methylated-CpG status, local trinucleotide context, replication timing if available, and gene constraint. Use only variants classified as synonymous in the locked transcript set; exclude codon changes affecting splice motifs or overlapping regulatory annotations. Fit a neutral-context model from noncoding or fourfold-degenerate sites, subtract expected mutation burden, and aggregate the residual by codon to x. Residualize x against C plus explicit CpG/UpA and local trinucleotide mutability columns; normalize to d_resid4.
controls: The raw axis is DNA damage/repair or mutability residual, not translation efficiency, tRNA supply, ribosome dwell, mRNA stability, or codon-pair usage.
GC1/GC2/GC3/total_GC, CpG, TpA/UpA, methylation, trinucleotide mutation opportunity, codon-pair scores, mRNA-stability scores, and dwell scores are controls.
Exclude disease-enriched, splice-proximal, nonsense-adjacent, and overlapping functional elements.
Repeat in separate ancestry groups and in de novo-only data; the candidate is rejected if projection exists only in one ascertainment source.
Negative control: use intronic pseudo-codons in the same genes and reading-frame phases; they must not reproduce the SerSplit projection.
data_sources: gnomAD or comparable population coding SNV table: variant, allele count, allele number, gene, transcript, codon position, ancestral/ref/alt allele, consequence
de novo mutation or near-neutral pedigree mutation table with callable opportunity mask
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation: transcript sequence, codon, reading frame, exon, strand
COSMIC/PCAWG mutational-signature exposure table only as a control source, not as the raw axis
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if GC/CpG/trinucleotide context explains the residual, if coding selection or splice/regulatory overlap drives the score, if the 61-codon opportunity table is incomplete, or if SerSplit projection is absent in de novo mutation data.
candidate_axes.name: synonymous_DNA_damage_repair_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the editing residual axis. Report projections separately for A-to-I-only, C-to-U-only, and combined axes; only preregistered combined or replicated type-specific projections are considered candidate hits.
candidate_axes.construction: Map high-confidence RNA editing sites into CDS codons. For each sense codon, compute editing burden per callable expressed codon occurrence, separately for A-to-I and C-to-U, requiring minimum read depth and excluding known DNA variants. Normalize within tissue by expression, coverage, editable-base opportunity, and local sequence motif; combine tissues by median or random-effects meta-analysis to produce x. Residualize x against C plus expression, editable-base count, ADAR/APOBEC motif score, RBP density, and mRNA half-life; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: DNA SNPs and mapping-ambiguous sites are excluded.
mRNA stability, expression, coverage, local editing motif, GC, codon-pair, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, d_perp, wobble, and ribosome dwell are residualized or matched.
Run tissue leave-one-out and editing-type-specific audits.
Negative control: shift CDS reading frame by +1 and +2 before codon aggregation; shifted pseudo-codons must not reproduce the projection.
Reject if SerSplit projection is driven by a single tissue, transcript family, or editable-base composition.
data_sources: REDIportal, RADAR, or equivalent A-to-I and C-to-U RNA editing calls: genomic coordinate, transcript, editing type, editing level, coverage, tissue, strand
GTEx or ENCODE RNA-seq coverage/expression table for opportunity normalization
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation with codon coordinate and reading frame
mRNA half-life and RNA-binding-protein annotation tracks used only as controls
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if RNA editing burden is explained by editable-base composition, expression, mRNA half-life, local motifs, or mapping artifacts, or if coverage is insufficient for all 61 sense codons.
candidate_axes.name: coding_RNA_editing_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to each preregistered modification-type residual and to the combined residual after Holm correction over modification types. No biological-axis claim is made from a single unreplicated modification source.
candidate_axes.construction: Map mRNA modification calls inside coding regions to codon identity and codon position. For each sense codon, compute opportunity-normalized modification burden per expressed codon occurrence, stratified by modification type and codon position. Normalize within study and tissue by expression, coverage, modification-calling platform, local motif score, and codon-position opportunity; aggregate across studies by robust median to obtain x. Residualize x against C plus mRNA half-life, predicted local structure, RBP motif density, and known modification motifs; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: mRNA stability and local RNA structure are controls, not the candidate axis.
GC, motif content, codon-pair score, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, d_perp, wobble, and ribosome dwell are residualized.
Run platform-specific audits: antibody-based, nanopore/direct-RNA, and chemical-mapping calls are tested separately where available.
Negative control: use UTR modification calls randomly assigned to CDS codons by expression-matched transcript; projection must vanish.
Reject modification types with fewer than a preregistered minimum number of codon-mapped events.
data_sources: RMBase, m6A-Atlas, DirectRMDB, or equivalent transcriptome modification calls: modification type, coordinate, transcript, tissue/cell type, confidence, stoichiometry if available
GENCODE or Ensembl CDS annotation: transcript sequence, codon coordinate, reading frame
matched expression, mRNA half-life, local motif, and structure tracks used as controls
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if modification calls are motif/GC/stability artifacts, if platform bias dominates, if events are too sparse for 61 codons, or if SerSplit projection is not replicated across independent mapping technologies.
candidate_axes.name: mRNA_base_modification_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT to the MAVE residual codon-effect axis. Report public-only, assay-type-specific, and leave-one-gene projections; the route remains exploratory unless projection is stable across independent assays.
candidate_axes.construction: Extract only synonymous single-codon substitutions from multiplexed assays. Convert each variant score to an effect of using the alternate codon relative to the reference codon within the same amino acid and local protein position. Fit a mixed model with random intercepts for gene, assay, protein position, amino acid, source codon, target codon, and replicate; take the best linear unbiased codon-use effect for each of the 61 codons as x. Residualize x against C plus assay-specific RNA-structure, codon-pair, mRNA-stability, and dwell covariates; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: Only synonymous substitutions are used; nonsynonymous and splice/regulatory variants are excluded.
Amino-acid identity, gene, protein position, assay, source codon, target codon, expression, codon-pair, mRNA stability, ribosome dwell, GC, wobble, tRNA supply, f3/ramp, and d_perp are controlled.
Leave-one-gene-family and leave-one-assay-type audits are required.
Negative control: permute synonymous scores within amino acid and gene while preserving codon counts; projection must vanish.
Reject if SerSplit projection is carried by one gene, one assay, or one codon substitution direction.
data_sources: MaveDB and ProteinGym synonymous variant tables: variant sequence, reference codon, alternate codon, score, raw counts, replicate ID, assay type, selection condition
gene/transcript annotation for each MAVE library: CDS position, amino acid, codon context, expression construct, library design
matched codon-pair, RNA-structure, mRNA-stability, and ribosome-profiling controls for each assayed gene where available
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if MAVE coverage does not span all 61 codons, if effects are dominated by mRNA stability/codon-pair/dwell terms, if synonymous scores are too assay-specific, or if the model cannot identify codon effects separately from gene and position effects.
candidate_axes.name: synonymous_MAVE_effect_residual_axis

candidate_axes.audit_test: Apply TEST_U_SERSPLIT separately to each lesion chemistry and to any preregistered combined lesion axis. Report whether projection survives explicit GC and nearest-neighbor residualization.
candidate_axes.construction: Synthesize oligos in which only the central codon varies across the 61 sense codons and all flanking bases, concentration, exposure, time, temperature, and buffer are identical. For each damage chemistry, estimate lesion rate per molecule from raw replicate counts. Within chemistry and replicate batch, z-score lesion rates; aggregate independent chemistries only if preregistered or keep separate axes. The raw codon lesion vector x is then residualized against C plus explicit base-composition, purine/pyrimidine, CpG/UpA, and nearest-neighbor thermodynamic controls; normalize residual to d_resid4.
controls: No tRNA, codon usage, mRNA stability, codon-pair, ribosome, or expression data enter the raw axis.
Identical flanking contexts remove codon-pair and local transcript-context effects at the experimental design stage.
GC, nearest-neighbor chemistry, CpG/UpA, and base-position composition are residualized.
Run DNA-only and RNA-only panels separately; projection must not depend on a single chemistry unless that chemistry was preregistered.
Negative control: replicate the panel with scrambled codon labels before analysis; projection must vanish.
data_sources: bounded 61-sense-codon synthetic DNA oligo panel with identical flanking sequence on both sides of the codon
bounded 61-sense-codon synthetic RNA oligo panel with identical flanking sequence on both sides of the codon
LC-MS, primer-extension, nanopore, or sequencing readouts for UV dimerization, oxidative lesions, hydrolytic deamination, and alkylation under fixed exposure conditions
candidate_axes.failure_mode: Fails if lesion-rate differences are fully explained by GC/base composition or nearest-neighbor chemistry, if replicate variance is too high, if synthesis bias differs by codon, or if no residual projection onto u_SerSplit remains.
candidate_axes.name: matched_trinucleotide_chemical_lesion_residual_axis

data_requests: Locked 61-sense-codon order used by codon_q6_selection_vectors.v1, with RNA codon spelling convention fixed as U/C/A/G.

Existing 64-row selection-vector packet and a 61-row sense-only extract with amino_acid, codon, is_sense, q6_bits, q6_label, d_perp_loading, f3_loading, optimal_loading, trna_consensus_loading, trna_supply_tai_centered_loading, and trna_supply_tai_mean.

Forbidden-control table C_base for the same 61 codons: intercept, 20 amino-acid one-hot columns, GC1, GC2, GC3, total_GC, CpG, UpA, purine/pyrimidine position indicators, wobble class, codon-family degeneracy, and any local graph covariates already used in the Window6--Codon-Q6 bridge.

Codon-pair control table: for each codon, incoming codon-pair residual score, outgoing codon-pair residual score, source organism, transcript set, normalization method, and whether stop-adjacent pairs were excluded.

mRNA-stability control table: per-codon matched-context predicted deltaG or stability contribution, source transcriptome, window size, folding software/version, expression weighting, and GC-controlled residual.

ribosome-dwell control table: per-codon dwell or pause residual from matched ribosome-profiling sources, source organism, protocol, footprint length handling, A/P/E-site assignment, expression threshold, and existing tRNA/GC/stability residualization status.

For tRNA-modification route: MODOMICS/GtRNAdb/tRNADB-CE joined table with organism, tRNA ID, isotype, anticodon, decoded codon set, mature sequence, modification position, modification identity, enzyme, evidence, and abundance/gene-copy columns marked as controls only.

For aaRS route: machine-readable kinetic table with organism, aaRS identity, tRNA substrate ID, anticodon, decoded codon, amino acid, kcat, Km, kcat/Km, replicate, temperature, pH, buffer, assay method, mutation status, and literature source.

For EF-Tu/EF1A route: binding table with organism, elongation factor, charged tRNA substrate ID, amino acid, anticodon, decoded codon, Kd or deltaG, kon, koff if available, buffer, temperature, replicate, modification state, and source.

For alternative-code route: codon reassignment event table with codon, standard assignment, observed assignment, taxon/clade, genome IDs, evidence type, confidence, inferred mechanism, GC content, codon disappearance score, tRNA-loss annotation, and phylogenetic deduplication ID.

For DNA mutability route: codon opportunity table, coding SNV table, de novo mutation table, methylation/CpG flags, local trinucleotide context, callable bases, transcript annotation, and filters for splice/regulatory overlap.

For RNA editing and mRNA modification routes: CDS-mapped event calls with transcript, coordinate, codon, codon position, event type, confidence, coverage, expression, tissue/cell type, platform, known DNA-variant exclusion, local motif, and mRNA half-life control.

For MAVE route: synonymous variant score table with raw counts, normalized scores, replicate IDs, reference codon, alternate codon, amino acid, gene, protein position, assay type, library design, and RNA/codon-context annotations.

For synthetic lesion route: raw replicate count matrix for 61 matched-flank DNA/RNA oligos, synthesis QC, concentration, exposure condition, chemistry, readout method, batch, and codon label key stored separately until after QC.
tests: TEST_AXIS_ADMISSIBILITY: For each candidate raw vector x, require one finite numeric value for every one of the 61 standard-code sense codons in the locked order. Missing codons, imputed codons not declared before testing, or post-hoc source changes make the candidate inadmissible.

TEST_FORBIDDEN_MATRIX: Build C from intercept, amino-acid one-hot, d_perp_loading, f3_loading, optimal_loading, trna_consensus_loading, trna_supply_tai_centered_loading, GC1, GC2, GC3, total_GC, CpG, UpA, wobble class, codon-family degeneracy, codon-pair incoming/outgoing residuals, mRNA-stability score, ribosome-dwell score, and any candidate-specific nuisance columns. Center and scale non-binary columns; drop linearly dependent columns by QR with locked tolerance 1e-10; set P_C=C(C^T C)^+C^T.

TEST_RESIDUALIZATION: For each x, compute r=(I-P_C)x. Reject if ||r||_2 <= 1e-12 or if any forbidden covariate predicts r in leave-one-source cross-validation with adjusted R2 >= 0.05. Define d_resid4=r/||r||_2 only after this rejection check is passed.

TEST_U_SERSPLIT: Let S4={UCU,UCC,UCA,UCG} and S2={AGU,AGC}. Define u_i=1/sqrt(12) for codons in S4, u_i=-2/sqrt(12) for codons in S2, and u_i=0 otherwise, in the locked 61-codon order. Compute u_r=(I-P_C)u. If ||u_r||_2 <= 1e-12, the SerSplit projection is not testable under the chosen controls. Otherwise define v=u_r/||u_r||_2 and rho=<d_resid4,v>; rho_abs=abs(rho).

TEST_WITHIN_SER_EXACT_NULL: Enumerate all 15 partitions of the six Ser codons into A of size 4 and B of size 2. For each partition define u_A,B with +1/sqrt(12) on A and -2/sqrt(12) on B, residualize by (I-P_C), discard zero residual contrasts, normalize, and compute T_A,B=abs(<d_resid4,v_A,B>). The exact within-Ser p-value is (number of retained partitions with T_A,B >= rho_abs)/(number of retained partitions).

TEST_SIXFOLD_FAMILY_EXACT_NULL: Enumerate every 4-versus-2 partition within each six-codon amino-acid family Ser, Leu, and Arg. Residualize, normalize, and compute absolute projections as above. The exact sixfold-family p-value is the fraction of retained contrasts with projection >= rho_abs. This tests whether the natural Ser split is exceptional relative to same-degeneracy amino-acid families, not whether it is biologically true.

TEST_GLOBAL_MATCHED_SUPPORT_NULL: Enumerate or Monte Carlo preregister all disjoint codon sets A,B with |A|=4 and |B|=2 that match the SerSplit contrast on total GC count and wobble-class counts; form the same zero-sum normalized contrast, residualize against C, normalize, and compare absolute projections to rho_abs. If exact enumeration exceeds the locked compute budget, use a stored seed and at least 1000000 matched draws, reported as an approximation rather than exact.

TEST_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATE_CONTROL: Because candidate_axes are generators, apply Holm correction to projection p-values across all admitted axes and all preregistered subaxes. Passing this test is a flag for further audit, not a scientific verdict.

TEST_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS: For each admitted axis, run the route-specific label, position, source, shifted-frame, or pseudo-codon negative controls. A candidate is rejected if any negative control gives a SerSplit projection with the same sign and at least 80% of rho_abs.

TEST_REPRODUCIBILITY: Split each data source by organism, clade, tissue, assay, platform, or batch as applicable. Reconstruct x, r, d_resid4, and rho in each split. Reject if the material projection is caused by one split or if sign is unstable after the sign convention is locked on the training split.
